just_in.title: DMK MLA GV Markandeyan Arrested Over Threatening Remarks Against Tamil Nadu CM Vijay
just_in.excerpt: The Vilathikulam legislator was detained by police after allegedly making threatening and controversial remarks against Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay at a public meeting in Kovilpatti, marking the second arrest of a DMK MLA over anti-Vijay remarks in recent weeks.
just_in.image_caption: A political demonstration in India. DMK MLA GV Markandeyan was arrested in Tamil Nadu for remarks against Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay.
just_in.nri_angle: The arrest deepens Tamil Nadu's ruling TVK-opposition DMK confrontation, a political fault line closely watched by the global Tamil diaspora with strong ties to Dravidian party politics.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: India Targets $200 Billion in AI Infrastructure Investment by 2028
just_in.excerpt: IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw unveiled an aggressive plan at the AI Impact Summit to position India as a global AI computing hub, backed by tax holidays through 2047, a ₹100 billion venture fund, and commitments from Amazon, Google, and Microsoft.
just_in.image_caption: Server racks inside a data center facility. India aims to attract over $200 billion in AI infrastructure investment by 2028, including hyperscale data centers across the country.
just_in.nri_angle: India's massive AI infrastructure push creates significant opportunities for NRI tech professionals and investors looking to participate in the country's AI buildout.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: U.S. Launches Sweeping H-1B and PERM Fraud Probe With Dozens of Subpoenas
just_in.excerpt: The Department of Labor's Inspector General has opened a major investigation into alleged visa fraud, wage theft, and human trafficking across H-1B and PERM labor certification programs, with IT firm Cognizant among companies under scrutiny.
just_in.image_caption: Immigration and visa application documents on a desk. The Department of Labor's Inspector General has launched a major fraud probe targeting the H-1B and PERM programs.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian nationals receive roughly 70 percent of H-1B approvals, and major Indian IT firms including Cognizant, Infosys, and TCS are among the largest program users, making this investigation directly relevant to hundreds of thousands of Indian professionals in the U.S. and the companies that employ them.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Student Loan Defaults Surge Past 9 Million as Post-Pandemic Repayment Crisis Deepens
just_in.excerpt: Nearly 3.6 million Americans defaulted on federal student loans in just six months. With wage garnishments resuming and the SAVE plan dead, millions more face a ticking clock.
just_in.image_caption: Federal student loan borrowers face mounting pressure as default numbers reach historic highs following the end of pandemic-era payment protections. The Department of Education reported 9.57 million borrowers in default as of March 2026.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian Americans with federal student loans face the same default risks and wage garnishment enforcement, while Indian students on F-1 visas managing private education loans are fast-tracking repayments amid visa and employment uncertainties.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Set for Marvel's Biggest India Opening Since Avengers: Endgame
just_in.excerpt: With 200,000-plus tickets already sold and ₹15 crore in weekend pre-sales, Tom Holland's fourth Spider-Man outing is projected to open at ₹45-50 crore on July 31.
just_in.image_caption: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is generating record-breaking advance bookings in India. The Tom Holland starrer is set to release in six languages on July 31.
just_in.nri_angle: Spider-Man's massive India opening reflects the MCU's deep cultural penetration among young Indian audiences, while the film's six-language release strategy signals Hollywood's growing investment in the Indian market.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Dhamaal 4 Crosses ₹170 Crore Worldwide as Ajay Devgn Comedy Enters Bollywood's 100-Crore Club
just_in.excerpt: The franchise's fourth instalment surpassed Total Dhamaal's opening-week record and has become Bollywood's fifth highest-grossing film of 2026, though The Odyssey now threatens its screen count.
just_in.image_caption: Ajay Devgn stars in Dhamaal 4, the latest instalment of the hit comedy franchise. The film has crossed ₹170 crore worldwide in 10 days.
just_in.nri_angle: Bollywood comedies like Dhamaal remain cultural touchstones for the Indian diaspora, and the franchise's overseas gross of nearly ₹20 crore reflects strong NRI interest.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Bezos-Backed CuspAI Raises $450 Million at $2.6 Billion Valuation to Discover New Chipmaking Materials
just_in.excerpt: The Cambridge-based startup uses AI to simulate and discover materials for semiconductors and clean energy, with ASML, Meta, and Nvidia among its early customers.
just_in.image_caption: A semiconductor fabrication facility. CuspAI is using artificial intelligence to discover new materials that could make chipmaking cheaper and less resource-intensive.
just_in.nri_angle: India's semiconductor ambitions — including the $13.3 billion chip package and Tata-Micron fab projects — stand to benefit from breakthroughs in AI-driven materials discovery that could reshape global chip supply chains.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Indian Seafarers Among Dead as Russian Missile Strikes Grain Ship Off Ukraine's Coast
just_in.excerpt: At least five crew members were killed when Russian forces hit a Guinea-Bissau-flagged corn cargo vessel in the Black Sea, with Indian and Syrian sailors among the 17-member international crew.
just_in.image_caption: A cargo vessel in the Black Sea. Russian forces struck a corn-laden ship carrying an international crew that included Indian and Syrian sailors, killing at least five.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian seafarers make up a significant share of the global merchant navy; this attack underscores the risks they face in active conflict zones critical to global food supply chains.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: 'Mega Masters' Hearings Pack Immigration Courts With 100-Plus Cases as Deportation Strategy Expands
just_in.excerpt: Immigration attorneys say the new tactic of scheduling mass hearings targets people without lawyers and is designed to generate deportation orders at scale.
just_in.image_caption: An immigration courtroom in the United States. New 'mega masters' hearings are scheduling more than 100 cases at a time, raising due process concerns among immigration attorneys.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian immigrants navigating the US court system — including those on overstayed visas or awaiting green card adjudication — face heightened risks from fast-tracked proceedings with minimal notice.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Indian Diaspora Groups Fight New Four-Year Student Visa Cap That Hits 300,000 Students
just_in.excerpt: The Foundation for India and Indian Diaspora Studies and other organisations are mobilising against a DHS rule that scraps the flexible 'duration of status' system, effective September 15.
just_in.image_caption: Indian students make up the largest group of international students in the United States. The new four-year visa cap threatens to disrupt academic and career plans for hundreds of thousands of Indian nationals.
just_in.image_credit: Photo by RDNE Stock project on Pexels
just_in.nri_angle: India is the largest source of F-1 students in the US; this rule directly impacts hundreds of thousands of Indian nationals and their families.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Police Cane Thousands of Cockroach Movement Supporters as 'Chalo Sansad' March Brings Delhi to a Standstill
just_in.excerpt: Around 10,000 protesters gathered at Jantar Mantar despite a police ban, demanding Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation over the NEET paper leak scandal.
just_in.image_caption: Supporters of India's Cockroach Janta Party gather at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi for the 'Chalo Sansad' march. Police deployed lathi charges and heavy barricades as thousands defied a ban on the protest.
just_in.nri_angle: India's largest youth-led protest in years highlights systemic failures in education that affect millions of families, including those with children in the diaspora considering Indian competitive exams.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Pakistan Summons Imran Khan's Sister After Remarks on Army's Inability to Defeat India
just_in.excerpt: Aleema Khan faces fresh legal action over controversial statements questioning Pakistan's military performance during the 2025 conflict with India and her praise of Prime Minister Modi's leadership.
just_in.image_caption: Former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan addressing a forum during his time in office. His sister Aleema Khan now faces legal summons for remarks criticizing the Pakistan Army's performance during the 2025 conflict with India.
just_in.nri_angle: Aleema Khan's acknowledgment of India's military superiority and praise for Modi from within a prominent Pakistani political family underscores shifting power dynamics that resonate with the Indian diaspora.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Tearful Scaloni Doubts Argentina Future as Messi Faces Final World Cup Curtain
just_in.excerpt: Argentina's head coach broke down at his post-match press conference after Spain's 1-0 extra-time World Cup final victory, while Messi's international career appears over at 39.
just_in.image_caption: Lionel Messi during Argentina's round-of-16 match against Egypt at the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The eight-time Ballon d'Or winner finished the tournament with eight goals and four assists but went scoreless in the final.
just_in.nri_angle: The World Cup final at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey drew massive global viewership, including millions of football fans across the Indian diaspora in the United States and worldwide.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: H-1B for Entrepreneurs: How to Self-Sponsor Your Visa Through Your Own Startup
just_in.excerpt: The H-1B Modernization Rule now lets founders sponsor themselves through their own companies — but USCIS demands specific corporate structures, specialty occupation proof, and prevailing wage compliance to approve the petition.
just_in.image_caption: An entrepreneur works at a desk reviewing business documents. The H-1B Modernization Final Rule now allows startup founders to self-sponsor H-1B visas through their own companies.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian nationals hold roughly 72% of H-1B approvals and face decade-long green card backlogs; the self-sponsorship pathway offers an alternative to remaining tied to a single employer for immigration status, especially relevant after waves of tech layoffs.

news.excerpt: Batarti Gabbard, 55, was arrested on custodial interference charges after allegedly offering children gum and money to accompany him to his hotel room. His family says he is in the grip of a mental health crisis.
news.image_caption: Tulsi Gabbard in her official portrait as Director of National Intelligence. Her older brother, Batarti Gabbard, has been charged with custodial interference after allegedly approaching children at a Waikiki hotel pool.
news.nri_angle: Tulsi Gabbard, the first Hindu elected to U.S. Congress, holds particular significance for the Indian-American community; the arrest of her brother adds a personal crisis to a politically prominent family with deep Hindu roots.

news.title: Indian Pilots Urge Government to Suspend All UAE Flights Amid Gulf Crisis
news.excerpt: The Airline Pilots' Association of India has demanded the DGCA halt commercial flights to the UAE and other high-risk Gulf airspace, calling continued operations 'wilful endangerment' as EASA warns of missile and drone threats through July 29.
news.image_caption: Two pilots navigate a commercial aircraft cockpit during flight. India's largest pilot association has demanded the government suspend all flights to the UAE and Gulf conflict zones as US-Iran military exchanges intensify.
news.nri_angle: An estimated 3.5 million Indian nationals in the UAE face travel uncertainty as Indian pilots demand flight suspensions and over 15,000 Indian seafarers remain stranded near the Strait of Hormuz.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Taiwan Reports 83% Surge in Chinese Vessel Activity Near Island
news.excerpt: Coast guard data shows 55 Chinese government vessel sightings around Taiwan in June, up from 30 in May, as Taipei plans drills to counter potential blockade of Pacific supply routes.
news.image_caption: A coast guard vessel patrols open waters. Taiwan reported 55 Chinese government vessel sightings around the island in June 2026, an 83% increase from the previous month.
news.nri_angle: A potential Taiwan blockade could disrupt semiconductor exports and supply chains critical to India's economy, with Taiwanese firms like Powerchip already partnering with Tata Group on India's first chip fab in Gujarat.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Thousands March on Parliament as NEET Protests and Lathi Charges Mark Monsoon Session Opening
news.excerpt: Police used tear gas and batons against CJP protesters attempting to reach Parliament on the first day of the monsoon session, as opposition leaders forced repeated adjournments in both Houses over NEET irregularities and Sonam Wangchuk's hunger strike.
news.image_caption: Security forces face off with protesters during a demonstration in Delhi. Thousands of Cockroach Janta Party supporters attempted to march from Jantar Mantar toward Parliament on Monday, clashing with police who deployed tear gas and lathi charges.
news.nri_angle: The NEET paper leak has directly affected thousands of Indian-origin medical aspirants worldwide who sat the exam, while the CJP movement's 22-million Instagram following includes significant diaspora participation.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India's 'Yo-Yo' Monsoon Whipsaws Between Drought and Deadly Floods, Threatening Crops and the Power Grid
news.excerpt: After weeks of El Niño-driven dry weather that slashed hydropower output by a fifth and delayed kharif sowing, torrential rains have suddenly killed at least 25 people — exposing the dangerous volatility of the 2026 monsoon season.
news.image_caption: A flooded paddy field in Raichur district, Karnataka, during the monsoon season. India's 2026 monsoon has swung between prolonged dry spells and sudden deluges, threatening both crops and the power grid.
news.image_credit: Vraj Acharya, WELL Labs / Wikimedia Commons / CC BY-SA 4.0
news.nri_angle: NRI families with agricultural land face heightened uncertainty over kharif crop yields and rental incomes. Rising food prices in India affect remittance purchasing power, while erratic weather complicates monsoon-season travel plans.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Madhya Pradesh Cabinet Approves Uniform Civil Code Bill as Assembly Session Opens Today
news.excerpt: The bill, modelled on Uttarakhand's UCC, bans polygamy across religions and mandates registration of live-in relationships, with penalties of up to five years in prison.
news.image_caption: An Indian government building. The Madhya Pradesh cabinet approved the Uniform Civil Code Bill-2026 on Sunday ahead of the Assembly monsoon session.
news.image_credit: Photo by Sachin Rawat on Pexels
news.nri_angle: The UCC debate resonates with NRIs navigating personal law across jurisdictions.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: US Strikes Iran for Ninth Straight Night as Brent Oil Tops $90 and Ceasefire Collapses
news.excerpt: Explosions reported across southern Iran and in Tabriz for the first time, while a third American soldier is confirmed killed and oil prices hit their highest level since June.
news.image_caption: A satellite view of the Strait of Hormuz, the narrow waterway between Iran and the Arabian Peninsula that handles roughly one-fifth of global oil trade. Shipping traffic through the strait has dropped sharply as the US and Iran impose competing naval restrictions.
news.nri_angle: Rising oil prices and the widening conflict have direct implications for Indians in the Gulf states, where air raid sirens have sounded in Bahrain and Kuwait has faced attacks on civilian infrastructure.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Pakistan Faces Pressure on Four Fronts as Balochistan, Houthis, and Afghan Border Crises Converge
news.excerpt: From a Baloch insurgency threatening Chinese mines to Houthi attacks risking military entanglement with Saudi Arabia, Pakistan confronts simultaneous security challenges that could reshape the region.
news.image_caption: Pakistani soldiers stand in formation during a military event. The country's armed forces are stretched across multiple fronts, from Balochistan's insurgency to deployments in Saudi Arabia.
news.nri_angle: India's reopening of its Kabul embassy and growing engagement with Afghanistan complicates Pakistan's strategic calculus, with implications for India-Pakistan dynamics.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Ship Fire Jolts Strait of Hormuz as US-Iran Attacks Widen to Kuwait, Bahrain and Jordan
news.excerpt: A vessel burns near Oman as the US conducts its ninth straight night of strikes on Iran and Tehran hits Gulf state infrastructure, sending Brent crude above $90 a barrel.
news.image_caption: A satellite view of the Strait of Hormuz and the Musandam Peninsula captured by NASA's MODIS instrument. The narrow waterway normally carries one-fifth of the world's oil shipments but transit has slowed to a trickle amid the US-Iran conflict.
news.nri_angle: Oil price surge hits India's import bill directly while 8.9 million Indians in the Gulf face growing safety and travel disruptions.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Europe's Heatwave Becomes an Energy Crisis as France Shuts Nuclear Reactors and Rhine Shipping Stalls
news.excerpt: Record temperatures have forced France to cut 6.4 GW of nuclear power while the Rhine River drops to its lowest mid-July level in decades, compounding Europe's energy woes from the Strait of Hormuz crisis.
news.image_caption: Cooling towers of a power plant stand alongside a river at sunset. Record-high river temperatures across France and Germany have forced the shutdown of nuclear reactors that depend on water for cooling.
news.nri_angle: Higher European energy costs affect NRIs across the continent while global commodity prices feed through to India's import bill.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Rare 'Atlantic Niña' Emerges Alongside Super El Niño, Creating Unusual Double Shield Against Hurricanes
news.excerpt: Two opposing ocean anomalies are working in rare alignment to suppress Atlantic hurricane activity, but the combination could amplify extreme heat and weaken the Indian monsoon.
news.image_caption: A satellite view of a tropical ocean system. The rare emergence of an Atlantic Niña alongside a Super El Niño has created an unusual dual climate anomaly that is suppressing Atlantic hurricane activity in 2026.
news.nri_angle: El Niño historically weakens the Indian monsoon, directly affecting agricultural output and commodity prices that Indian diaspora families track closely.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: US Death Toll in Iran War Rises to 17 as Military Recovers Remains of Missing Soldier in Jordan
news.excerpt: A third service member was killed during a drone disposal operation in Iraq as the conflict enters its eighth consecutive night of strikes, with Hormuz shipping at a standstill.
news.image_caption: A US military helicopter operates from a naval vessel in the Middle East. The US death toll in the Iran war has risen to 17 after three service members were killed this weekend.
news.nri_angle: The escalating US-Iran conflict directly affects Indian diaspora communities in the Gulf, disrupts travel corridors to India, and is driving inflation through surging energy prices.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Woman Throws Ink at CJP Founder Abhijeet Dipke at Jantar Mantar Protest
news.excerpt: The attacker was identified as a men’s rights activist who had previously supported convicted rapist Kuldeep Singh Sengar. The incident came as activists and students intensified protests over the NEET paper leak.
news.image_caption: Protesters hold placards during a demonstration. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke had ink thrown at him by a woman at the Jantar Mantar protest site in Delhi on July 18.
news.nri_angle: The Cockroach Janta Party movement, driven by India’s youth anger over exam corruption and unemployment, has resonated with diaspora communities whose families in India are directly affected by education system failures.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Indian Envoy Meets Distressed Women Workers in Oman, Pledges Quick Action
nri-world.excerpt: Ambassador Prashant Pise visited Indian women at the embassy's shelter in Muscat, hearing their complaints of abuse, wage theft and abandonment by employers.
nri-world.image_caption: An aerial view of Muscat, Oman's capital, where the Indian Embassy runs a shelter for distressed workers. India's ambassador met women domestic workers at the facility on Monday to hear their grievances.
nri-world.nri_angle: Indian women from economically vulnerable backgrounds, often recruited through fraudulent agents, face exploitation as domestic workers in Gulf countries, highlighting the need for stronger protections for the diaspora's most vulnerable members.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Rajiv Meherish, Founder of Dubai's Raju Omlet Chain, Dies at His UAE Home
nri-world.excerpt: The Mumbai-born entrepreneur built a single-product egg restaurant into an eight-outlet chain studied by Harvard Business Review. He had lived in the UAE for over four decades.
nri-world.image_caption: An omelette dish of the kind served at Raju Omlet outlets across the UAE. Founder Rajiv Meherish built the chain from a single 18-seat restaurant in Dubai's Al Karama to eight locations before his death on July 19, 2026.
nri-world.nri_angle: Meherish's four-decade journey from Mumbai to Dubai epitomised the entrepreneurial arc of the Indian diaspora in the Gulf, building a brand that became a cultural touchstone for South Asian expatriates.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Indian-Origin Student Vaibhav Bhaskar Sets Florida's Highest-Ever GPA at 11.99
nri-world.excerpt: The Steinbrenner High School valedictorian took 44 advanced courses, earned an associate degree, and is headed to Duke University — all while running a nonprofit for the homeless.
nri-world.image_caption: A student celebrates graduation day in cap and gown. Vaibhav Bhaskar graduated as valedictorian from Steinbrenner High School with an 11.99 weighted GPA.
nri-world.nri_angle: Indian-American student from a family with roots in Indian academia sets Florida state record for highest-ever high school GPA, adding to the pattern of Indian-origin students excelling in American education. His father, a Ph.D. chemist, represents the immigrant science professionals whose children are now charting their own paths in fields like finance.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Parliament’s Monsoon Session Opens With Seven Bills and the Delimitation Question
nri-world.excerpt: The government has listed five new bills and two pending ones for the session running July 20 to August 13, but the politically explosive delimitation proposal remains conspicuously absent from the official agenda.
nri-world.image_caption: India’s new Parliament building in New Delhi, inaugurated in 2023. The Monsoon Session beginning July 20 will run for 19 sittings through August 13.
nri-world.nri_angle: The session’s legislative agenda — spanning taxation, foreign contribution regulation and potential delimitation — could reshape the policy landscape that NRIs navigate when engaging with India on property, investments and civic rights.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Usha and JD Vance Welcome Son Alec Neel, First Baby Born to a Sitting VP in 156 Years
nri-world.excerpt: The Indian-American second lady gave birth at Walter Reed Medical Center on Sunday, making history as the first VP spouse to have a child in office since 1870.
nri-world.image_caption: Usha Vance in her official 2025 portrait as second lady of the United States. She gave birth to the couple's fourth child, Alec Neel Vance, on July 19, 2026.
nri-world.nri_angle: Usha Vance, née Chilukuri, is the daughter of Indian immigrants from Andhra Pradesh and is the highest-ranking Indian-American in the executive branch.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: India Set to Make Insulting Vande Mataram a Criminal Offence as Bill Heads to Parliament
nri-world.excerpt: The Prevention of Insults to National Honour Amendment Bill would extend the same statutory protections currently afforded to the national anthem to India's national song.
nri-world.image_caption: Union Home Minister Amit Shah at a public event. Shah is set to table the Prevention of Insults to National Honour Amendment Bill during the ongoing Monsoon Session of Parliament.
nri-world.nri_angle: The bill to criminalize insults to Vande Mataram carries deep cultural significance for the Indian diaspora, who grew up singing the national song and view it as a symbol of patriotic identity.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Sonam Wangchuk's Wife Vows to Lead Parliament March as Court Upholds Hospital Move
nri-world.excerpt: Gitanjali Angmo pledges to represent her husband at the July 20 march to Parliament while the Delhi High Court rules his forced hospitalization was lawful.
nri-world.image_caption: Climate activist and engineer Sonam Wangchuk has been on a hunger strike since June 28 in solidarity with the Cockroach Janta Party's education reform demands. He was moved to a government hospital on Saturday.
nri-world.nri_angle: Wangchuk's activism resonates with the Indian diaspora, which has closely followed his campaigns for Ladakh and education reform.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Goldman Sachs Bans Staff From Betting on Elections and Markets on Prediction Platforms
nri-world.excerpt: Wall Street banks restrict employee trading on Kalshi and Polymarket amid insider trading cases, allowing bets only on sports and entertainment.
nri-world.image_caption: Goldman Sachs headquarters at 200 West Street in Lower Manhattan, New York. The bank has banned employees from prediction market bets tied to finance and politics.
nri-world.nri_angle: Thousands of Indian-origin professionals at Goldman and other Wall Street banks face new compliance restrictions on prediction market trading.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: India and Spain to Fast-Track UPI-Bizum Interoperability Talks
nri-world.excerpt: As RBI expands UPI's global footprint and Europe's Bizum network consolidates, India and Spain are accelerating discussions to link their real-time payment systems for cross-border transactions.
nri-world.image_caption: The UPI logo. India and Spain are fast-tracking talks to link UPI with Spain's Bizum mobile payment system as part of India's push to internationalize its digital payments infrastructure (Wikimedia Commons)
nri-world.nri_angle: For Indian professionals and students in Spain, UPI-Bizum interoperability would eliminate the friction and fees of traditional remittances, letting them pay at Spanish shops via UPI and receive money from India instantly.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: How NRIs Can Legally Reduce Capital Gains Tax When Selling Indian Investments Under the New Tax Act
nri-world.excerpt: Section 215 of the Income Tax Act, 2025 allows eligible non-resident Indians to claim exemption from long-term capital gains tax, but the benefit comes with strict conditions on how the original investment was made.

carousel.title: India Targets $200 Billion in AI Infrastructure Investment by 2028
carousel.excerpt: IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw unveiled an aggressive plan at the AI Impact Summit to position India as a global AI computing hub, backed by tax holidays through 2047, a ₹100 billion venture fund, and commitments from Amazon, Google, and Microsoft.
carousel.image_caption: Server racks inside a data center facility. India aims to attract over $200 billion in AI infrastructure investment by 2028, including hyperscale data centers across the country.
carousel.nri_angle: India's massive AI infrastructure push creates significant opportunities for NRI tech professionals and investors looking to participate in the country's AI buildout.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: HDFC Bank Shares Slide 5% as Margin Squeeze Overshadows Steady Q1 Profit Growth
carousel.excerpt: India's largest private lender lost nearly Rs 70,000 crore in market value after reporting a sharper-than-expected decline in net interest margins, even as brokerages maintained bullish targets.
carousel.image_caption: A stock market trading screen displays price movements and financial data. HDFC Bank shares fell over 5% on Monday, wiping out nearly Rs 70,000 crore in market value after June-quarter margins disappointed.
carousel.nri_angle: HDFC Bank remains one of the most widely held Indian stocks by NRI investors, and the bank's FCNR(B) deposit scheme for foreign-currency non-resident deposits is a direct product relevant to diaspora savers.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
